🚨 @noreaga  reveals he has an unreleased collaboration with Nas that was recorded in just 20 minutes! 👀 So why has the track never seen the light of day. “I would like to do something else with him.” — N.O.R.E.

🚨Hip-hop doesn't just shape music—it shapes culture and media. 🔥 @noreaga  and @djEFN  talk about how the genre has evolved, giving fans unprecedented access to the personalities, stories, and experiences behind some of their favorite artists.Check out the full interview on @netflix right now! 📺

🚨Every successful media outlet has an interview that catapults them into another hemisphere! 🚀 @noreaga  and @djEFN  reflect on how their interview with DMX did just that for them and how they were able to land it, knowing X wasn’t doing interviews at the time. Check out the full interview on @netflix !

🚨Today, we’re celebrating the 10-year anniversary of @drinkchamps! 🥂 @noreaga and @djefn look back on what birthed the concept, the interviews that caused the most controversy, and the backstories behind their conversations with Kodak Black, Kanye West, and more. Check out the full conversation of the lessons learned from their journey on @netflix!

How can @essencefest evolve without losing a generation or two? @richelieud explains how he’s tasked with the challenge of creating an experience that serves all generations—ensuring that no one is left behind—and shares that this is the goal of @essencefest

🚨 @Richelieud expresses his confidence in the 2026 @essencefest, even after the challenges experienced. He dives deep into the execution of it all and how the adjustments made will make this year better than the last! 🚨 After @mcnuttmonica was caught on a hot mic questioning whether Taylor Swift was really a Knicks fan during Game 4, Monica stopped by to clear the air. 👀🏀
"I have not seen her all season." — Monica McNutt

Video

🚨 @McNuttMonica  stopped by to break down the NBA Finals, the Knicks’ historic playoff run, and why this team has the entire city believing. 🏀🔥 But the big question remains: Can the Knicks finish the job? Monica shares her predictions and what she thinks it’ll take for New York to bring home a championship. 👀🏆

🚨 In recent news 📰, Big Tigger is under investigation following allegations of domestic abuse involving his wife, Alicia Brown. An alleged altercation reportedly took place in May, and after providing her statement online, she decided to pull back and let the investigation run its course. Tap in as @lorenlorosa has the latest.
